docs.contenu:
🎯 Objectives
By the end of this lesson you will be able to:
- Name school subjects, objects and places.
- Talk about your hobbies and free-time activities.
- Say what you like and dislike using like / love / hate + -ing.
- Build simple sentences to describe your school day and your interests.

🔍 Warm-up
Answer quickly in your head: What is your favourite school subject? What do you do after school? This lesson gives you all the words you need to answer in English.

I. School vocabulary

📘 Rule (vocabulary — subjects)
School subjects are the lessons you study:
- Maths, English, Arabic, French, Science, History, Geography, Art, Music, Physical Education (P.E.), Computer Science.

📘 Rule (vocabulary — school objects)
Things you use in class:
- pen, pencil, rubber (eraser), ruler, pencil case, schoolbag, book, notebook, copybook, dictionary, board, desk, chair.

📘 Rule (vocabulary — school places and people)
- Places: classroom, library, playground, canteen, laboratory, office, gym.
- People: teacher, headmaster, pupil, student, classmate, friend.

✏️ Worked examples
- My favourite subject is Science.
- I keep my pens in my pencil case.
- We eat lunch in the canteen.
- The teacher writes on the board.

👀 Note
In British English we often say "copybook" or "exercise book" for the book you write in, and "rubber" for the tool that erases pencil. In American English it is "eraser". Both are correct.

II. Talking about the school day
📏 Form (useful sentences)
- I have + subject + on + day.
- Classes start / finish at + time.
- My favourite subject is + subject + because + reason.

✏️ Worked paragraph
I go to school five days a week. Classes start at eight o'clock. My favourite subject is English because it is useful and fun. On Mondays I have Maths, Science and Art. We have a break at ten. At lunchtime I eat in the canteen with my friends. School finishes at four.

🛠️ Method: giving a reason with "because"
Step 1 — Say what you like: I like History.
Step 2 — Add "because".
Step 3 — Give the reason: because it is interesting.
Result: I like History because it is interesting.

III. Hobbies and free-time activities

📘 Rule (vocabulary — hobbies)
Hobbies are activities you enjoy in your free time:
- Sports: playing football, swimming, cycling, running, playing basketball.
- Indoor: reading, drawing, painting, playing video games, listening to music, watching films, cooking.
- Creative and social: dancing, singing, taking photos, meeting friends.

📏 Form (talking about hobbies)
- In my free time I + verb.
- My hobby is + noun / -ing.
- I am good at + -ing.

✏️ Worked examples
- In my free time I play football and read comics.
- My hobby is drawing.
- I am good at swimming.

IV. Saying what you like and dislike

[[FIG]]<svg viewBox="0 0 680 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<text x="340" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="currentColor">Like / Love / Hate + -ing</text>
<rect x="30" y="50" width="150" height="60" rx="8" fill="#16a34a"/>
<text x="105" y="76" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">love / enjoy</text>
<text x="105" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#ffffff">very positive</text>
<rect x="195" y="50" width="150" height="60" rx="8" fill="#3b82f6"/>
<text x="270" y="76" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">like</text>
<text x="270" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#ffffff">positive</text>
<rect x="360" y="50" width="150" height="60" rx="8" fill="#e11d48" opacity="0.7"/>
<text x="435" y="76" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">don't like</text>
<text x="435" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#ffffff">negative</text>
<rect x="525" y="50" width="130" height="60" rx="8" fill="#e11d48"/>
<text x="590" y="76" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">hate</text>
<text x="590" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#ffffff">very negative</text>
<rect x="70" y="130" width="540" height="70" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
<text x="340" y="152" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="currentColor" font-weight="bold">Structure: verb + verb-ing</text>
<text x="340" y="172" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" font-style="italic">I love playing chess. She enjoys reading. They hate doing homework.</text>
<text x="340" y="190" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" font-style="italic">I don't like getting up early.</text>
</svg>[[/FIG]]
📘 Rule (grammar)
After the verbs like, love, enjoy, hate and don't like, we use a verb + -ing.
📏 Form
- like / love / enjoy / hate + verb-ing
- I love playing chess.
- She enjoys reading books.
- They hate doing homework.
- I don't like getting up early.

🛠️ Method: expressing your opinion about an activity
Step 1 — Choose your feeling: love / like / don't like / hate.
Step 2 — Add the activity with -ing: playing, reading, watching.
Step 3 — Add details if you want: I love playing football with my friends.

👀 Note
We can also say "My favourite hobby is..." + noun or -ing:
- My favourite hobby is reading.
- My favourite sport is basketball.

✏️ Worked paragraph
My name is Yassmine and I am twelve. At school my favourite subject is Art because I love drawing. In my free time I enjoy reading stories and listening to music. I don't like playing video games, but I love riding my bike in the park. At the weekend I usually meet my friends.

⚠️ Common mistakes
1. Forgetting -ing after like/love/hate: I like play → I like playing.
2. Using "have" for age: I have twelve → I am twelve.
3. Wrong word order: subject favourite my → my favourite subject.
4. Capital letters: subjects that are languages take a capital (English, French, Arabic); other subjects (maths, science) can be lower case, but at the start of a sentence always capitalise.

⭐ Recap
- Learn school words: subjects, objects, places, people.
- Talk about your school day with times and days.
- Use "because" to give reasons.
- Describe hobbies with "In my free time I..." and "My hobby is...".
- After like / love / enjoy / hate, use verb + -ing.

📘 Language bank
Subjects: Maths, English, Science, History, Geography, Art, Music, P.E., Computer Science.
Objects: pen, pencil, ruler, book, notebook, schoolbag, dictionary, board.
Hobbies: football, swimming, cycling, reading, drawing, painting, video games, music, dancing.
Feelings: I love, I like, I enjoy, I don't like, I hate.
Useful sentences: My favourite subject is English. / I have Science on Monday. / In my free time I play football. / I love reading. / I don't like getting up early.

📝 Practice
Exercise 1 — Put the words in the correct group: subject, object or place.
ruler, library, Science, playground, dictionary, History, canteen, notebook.
Subjects: ______
Objects: ______
Places: ______

Exercise 2 — Complete with the -ing form.
1. I love (read) ______ adventure stories.
2. She enjoys (draw) ______ animals.
3. They hate (do) ______ homework at the weekend.
4. My brother likes (play) ______ video games.
5. We don't like (get up) ______ early.

Exercise 3 — Answer about yourself.
1. What is your favourite subject and why?
2. What do you do in your free time?
3. Which hobby do you not like?

✅ Answers
Exercise 1: Subjects: Science, History. Objects: ruler, dictionary, notebook. Places: library, playground, canteen.
Exercise 2: 1. reading 2. drawing 3. doing 4. playing 5. getting up.

🗣️ Speaking task
Interview a partner about school and hobbies. Ask: "What is your favourite subject? Why? What do you do in your free time? What don't you like doing?" Then tell the class one interesting thing about your partner.

👀 Extra note
Remember two structures from this lesson:
1. After like, love, enjoy, hate and don't like, use the verb + -ing: I love reading, she enjoys drawing.
2. Use "because" to give a reason: I like English because it is useful.
Together these let you talk about all your interests in clear, natural English.

📋 Summary
- School vocabulary groups into subjects (Maths, English, Science...), objects (pen, ruler, notebook...), places (classroom, library, canteen) and people (teacher, pupil, classmate).
- Talk about the school day with times and days: "Classes start at eight. My favourite subject is... because..."
- Hobbies group into sports (football, swimming), indoor activities (reading, drawing, video games) and creative/social activities (dancing, meeting friends).
- Describe hobbies with "In my free time I...", "My hobby is...", "I am good at + -ing".
- After like, love, enjoy, hate and don't like, always use verb + -ing (I love playing, she enjoys reading).
- Use "because" to give a reason: "I like History because it is interesting."
- Common mistakes: forgetting -ing after like/love/hate, using "have" for age instead of "am", wrong word order for "favourite".
- Capital letters: language subjects (English, French, Arabic) always take a capital.

enonce.question: Name three school subjects in English.

Read what Hana says about her hobbies.
Hana: In my free time I ______ books about animals. I also ______ football with my brother, and in the evening I ______ to music.

1) Complete Hana's text with these verbs: play / read / listen.
2) Complete with your own answer: In my free time I ______.
3) Find the odd one out: reading / swimming / ruler / drawing.

Look at the things in Karim's schoolbag: a pen, a ruler, a pencil, a dictionary, a notebook, a book.

1) Which two things do you use to write?
2) Match each thing with its use.
Things: a) ruler — b) dictionary — c) notebook
Uses: 1. to find the meaning of words — 2. to draw straight lines — 3. to write the lessons in
3) Complete with a or an: I have ______ pen, ______ pencil and ______ English book.

Read about the music club.
Selim is in the music club at school. He likes ______ (play) the guitar. His friend Aya loves ______ (sing), but she hates ______ (dance).

1) Complete the text with the correct form of the verbs in brackets.
2) Complete the rule: after like, love, enjoy and hate, we use verb + ______.
3) Write the -ing form of: read, swim, draw.
4) Write one true sentence about you with I like + verb-ing.

Read Yasmine's timetable for Monday morning.
| Time | Lesson |
|---|---|
| 8:00 | Maths |
| 9:00 | Science |
| 10:00 | English |
| 11:00 | P.E. |

Yasmine: I love experiments, so my favourite ______ is Science.

1) Complete Yasmine's sentence with one word.
2) What does Yasmine have at ten o'clock? Answer with a full sentence.
3) Find the odd one out: History / Geography / ruler / Art.
4) Write about you: My favourite subject is ______ because ______.
What is the place where we borrow books?
Odd one out: football, tennis, pencil, swimming.

Read Bilel's short text about his hobby.
My hobby is drawing. I draw animals every weekend. I like drawing because it is relaxing.

1) What is Bilel's hobby? When does he draw?
2) Find in the text the word that gives a reason.
3) Use the notes to write two sentences about Sarra: hobby: swimming / when: every Friday.
4) Now write three sentences about your own hobby: say what it is, when you do it and why you like it.
Ask a classmate about their hobby.
